items.heading: Kottu Roti
details: Key ingredients: shredded roti, egg, vegetables, chicken or vegetables, curry sauce
Chop flatbread (roti) into small shreds.
Stir-fry vegetables, egg and meat together on a hot flat griddle.
Add the shredded roti and toss everything together with curry sauce.
Serve hot, traditionally with the rhythmic chopping sound of the griddle.

items.heading: Egg Hoppers
details: Key ingredients: rice flour, coconut milk, yeast, eggs
Ferment a batter of rice flour, coconut milk and a little yeast overnight.
Swirl a ladle of batter in a small curved pan to form a thin bowl shape.
Crack an egg into the center and cover to cook.
Serve with the edges crisp and the center soft.

items.heading: Fish Ambul Thiyal
details: Key ingredients: fish, goraka (tamarind substitute), black pepper, curry leaves
Marinate firm fish chunks in a dry spice paste with goraka and pepper.
Layer the fish in a clay pot with curry leaves.
Cook slowly with minimal liquid until the sauce thickens and clings to the fish.
Serve as a tangy, dry sour fish curry with rice.
